newsitem.title: USA: Hitachi America to consolidate units.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi America to consolidate units.

text.p: Hitachi America Ltd, a unit of Hitachi Ltd, on Friday said it would merge its Semiconductor & IC sales division in Brisbane, California with its Hitachi Semiconductor (America) Inc manufacturing unit in Irving, Texas.
The merger consolidates Hitachi America's sales and marketing, and semiconductor manufacturing operations into a single entity.
The new unit, which takes effect October 1, will be known as Hitachi Semiconductor (America) Inc and have its headquarters in Irving, Texas, Hitachi said.
Kosei Nomiya will become president and chief executive officer of the new company, effective June 27, 1997.
Hitachi Semiconductor (America) Inc produces a range of semiconductors, including memory chips, microcontrollers, application specific integrated circuits and other components.
